clips.title: The story
paras: At the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, a shaman prepares to kindle the Torch of the Dormant Flame. The unlit torch waits for a fire spirit's ember, earned on a mountaintop in Durotar.

A shaman seeking fire's favor carries the unlit Torch of the Dormant Flame up the peaks above Durotar. Fire sapta lets the shaman see a Minor Manifestation of Fire on the mountaintop and challenge it. When the spirit falls, its glowing ember goes into the weathered brazier at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. The shaman touches the torch's head to the white-hot blaze, and the wood awakens as a burning emblem of elemental mastery.
